text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: As they climbed the tower, {0} and his friends had reached a certain floor.
text_block_list.orig_text: 塔を登る{0}たちは、とあるフロアへと到達した。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: It seems there are no monsters here. Guess we've climbed quite a bit...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここには魔物はいないみたいだね。
結構登ってきたと思うんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Oh! Over there! There's something shining! Let's go check it out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ！　
あそこ！　
なにか光ってるッス！
行ってみるッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me... could that be...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかして、
あれが……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: It must! Could this be the hint to help {0} regain his memories?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あったッス！
これが
{0}さんの記憶を取り戻す
ヒントってやつッスかね？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: WE DID ITTTT! Phew... Thank goodness we made it this far without a hitch. If it was just us two, things might've been different. It's all thanks to you, Matsuri-chan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったぁ！　
ふぅ……
無事にここまで来れたね。
あたしたちだけだったら無理だったかも。
マツリちゃんのおかげだよ。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm happy to hear you say that, pal... Wait, huh...? Something's shining! This is...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ、
そう言ってもらえるとうれしいッス……
って、
あれ……？　
なにか光ってるッス！
これって……！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Hah?! Matsuri-chan?!
text_block_list.orig_text: マツリちゃん！？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Heehee... Thank you so much for coming today, pal!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ～……
今日は来てくれてありがとうッス！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Thanks to you, I was able to buy it! Tora Tiger's mask set! It's a rare item that is usually only sold at festival venues!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかげで買えたッス！
トラタイガーお面セット！
通常ならお祭り会場でしか売ってないレア品ッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: I got some for preservation, some for practical use, and some for spreading the love! It was worth saving my pocket money!
text_block_list.orig_text:
保存用と実用、
布教用とそろえちゃったッス！
お小遣い貯めてた甲斐があったッス！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Huh? I can hear something. Sounds like a dog barking... I have a feeling something's not right. Let's go and check it out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？　
何か聞こえるッスね。
犬の吠え声ッスけど……
ただごとじゃない予感がするッス。
行ってみるッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: There's indeed a dog barking and running around... Wh-What's going on?
text_block_list.orig_text:
犬が吠えながら走ってるッスね……
な、
なんなんッスかね？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: ...! Look, pal! Over there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！　
見るッス！　
あそこ！

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: FWEEEEEH...
text_block_list.orig_text: ふええ……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: A-A kid's crying! Don't tell me... is he crying because he's scared of dogs?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
子供が泣いてるッス！
もしかして、
犬の声が怖くて泣いてるッスかね？

text_block_list.name: Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof woof!
text_block_list.orig_text: ワンワン！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Hurry up, pal! We need to save that kid!
text_block_list.orig_text:
急ぐッスよ！
あの子のところに向かうッス！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: What's this here... A mask? Is it a lost item?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだろ、
これ……
お面？　
落とし物かな？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: It's right in front of the park, so maybe a kid dropped it on their way to play? Okay, I'll have to return it, then!
text_block_list.orig_text:
公園の目の前だし、
遊びに行く途中で落としたのかな？
よし、
届けてあげないとね。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: That dog... It looks so excited, running all over the place like that. Now's our chance to go help the kid.
text_block_list.orig_text:
犬は……
興奮して走り回ってるッスね。
今のうちにあの子のところに行くッスよ。

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Ugh... *sniff*...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううっ……
ぐすっ……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Are you okay, pal?! We're here, so you can put your worries at rest! What's wrong?
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫ッスか！？
自分たちが来たから安心するッスよ！
どうしたッスか？

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: You know, that dog...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのね、
犬がね……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: You're scared because he's running around barking, aren't you? Got it! Leave this to me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
吠えながら走りまわってて怖いッスね？
分かったッス！　
任せるッス！

text_block_list.name: Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof woof!
text_block_list.orig_text: ワンワン！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: A-Actually, on closer inspection, it's a pretty big dog... It'd probably hurt if you got bitten...
text_block_list.orig_text:
よ、
よく見ると、
結構大きな犬ッス……
噛みつかれたら痛そうッスね……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: I-I might be just a little scared... But I have to work up the courage...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、
ちょっとだけ怖いッス……
でも
勇気を出すしかないッス……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: O-Of course I'm fine! You're with me, so I know I won't lose, {0}-san!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へ、
平気に決まってるッス！
{0}さんが一緒にいるから
負けないッス！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah! A situation like this requires a transformation... My mask is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうッス！
こういう時は変身するッス……
このお面で……

text_block_list.name: Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof woof!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ワンワン！！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: IYAAAAAAH! T-That dog's looking at me... A-AAAHHAHHH, IT'S RUNNING OVER HERE! I need to hurry up and put on my mask so I can transform...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひゃあっ！　
い、
犬がこっちを見てるッス……
は、
ははは、
走ってきたッスよ！
早くお面をかぶって変身を……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: T-Transfo-...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へ、
へんし……！！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: TRANSFORM!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: へんしーん！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Huh? Huh...? Who's that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
え……
誰ッスか？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Umm... This mask, where is it from?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えーと……
このお面はなんのお面？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: It's from Tora Tiger...
text_block_list.orig_text: トラタイガーッス……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Tora Tiger... No. 3! Right, No. 2?
text_block_list.orig_text:
トラタイガー……
３号だよ！
ね、
２号？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: N-N-No! That's not me! Right now, I'm Tora Tiger No. 3! I've come here to save everyone!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちちちち、
ちがうよ！？
今のあたしは、
トラタイガー３号！
みんなを助けるために参上したのだー！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: I’m counting on you, Tiger No. 1! If things get dangerous, I’ll support you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
頼むよ、
トラタイガー１号！
危なくなったら、
サポートは任せて！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: A-All right, pal! I'll protect this child from that dog! It's okay, I'm not scared at all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
分かったッス！
あの犬からこの子を守るッス！
大丈夫、
怖くないッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Cheer up and help everyone... That's a hero's role!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなを元気づけて、
助ける……
それが、
ヒーローの役目ッスから！！

text_block_list.name: ひより
text_block_list.text:
フレー、
１号！
text_block_list.orig_text:
フレー、
１号！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: I-I'll leave my back to you, pal...! If that dog's planning on charging, then let it come!
text_block_list.orig_text:
せ、
背中は任せたッス……！
来るなら来いッスよーーーー！

text_block_list.name: Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof!
text_block_list.orig_text: わん！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is this little one, perhaps...? Don't be scared, come over here～
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？　
この子ってもしかして……
怖くないよ～、
こっちにおいで～

text_block_list.name: Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof, woof!
text_block_list.orig_text: わんわん！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Huh? Things got quiet all of a sudden... Is he not attacking you, No.3?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？　
急におとなしくなったッス……
３号になついてないッスか？

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: UWAAAAAAAH, Pochi!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わーん、
ポチー！

text_block_list.name: Dog
text_block_list.text: Kyuuu...
text_block_list.orig_text: きゅーん……

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Pochi's finally back!
text_block_list.orig_text: ポチがやっと帰ってきたー！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Umm... What's going on, pal?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと……
どういうことッスか？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: It seems this little one got too excited and started running around, so its owner, that kid, got desperate because he couldn't catch him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
興奮して走り回っちゃって、
飼い主の子にも捕まえられなくなっただけみたいだね。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Maybe he noticed us coming and returned to him?
text_block_list.orig_text: あたしたちに気付いて戻ってきたんじゃないかな？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: I-I see... *sigh* That's a relief...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうだったッスか……
はぁ～……
安心したッス……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: That reminds me. This mask is yours, isn't it? I'm Harusaki Hiyori. I borrowed it without permission because it was lying around. Sorry.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ。
このお面、
あなたのだよね？
あたしは
春咲ひより。
落ちてたの勝手に借りちゃった。
ごめんね。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: N-No such thing, pal! Ah, I'm Orihara Matsuri, pleased to meet you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんなことないッス！
あ、
自分は織原茉莉っていうッス！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: You're a friend of {0}-aniki, right? I should be the one thanking you for saving me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}さんのお友達ッスよね？
こっちこそ助けてもらってありがとうッス！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Nice to meet you, Matsuri-chan. But, make sure not to do anything reckless in the future, okay? Well, Senpai was there with you, so I figured you’d be fine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よろしくね、
茉莉ちゃん。
でも、
無茶はしちゃあだめだよ？
まあ先輩がいたから大丈夫だって思ってたけど。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: That was my bad. But I'm really impressed! Hiyori-san's courage! Your judgement! Your sense of justice! I definitely want to learn from your example!
text_block_list.orig_text:
面目ないッス。
でも自分、
感動したッス！
ひよりさんの度胸！　
判断力！　
正義感！　
ぜひ見習いたいッス！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... No way, you're exaggerating.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは……
そんな、
大げさだなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: No way I am, pal! Thanks to your support, Hiyori-san, I was able to face my fears!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなことあるッス！　
ひよりさんの応援のおかげで
自分は恐怖に立ち向かえたッスから！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: And above all, the way you just reconciled with the enemy... You're a real hero!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そしてなにより、
敵とも和解するその姿……
まさに
ヒーローッス！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... You're overreacting~ I just did what I could. Just like you have, Matsuri-chan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは……
オーバーだよ～
あたしはできることをしただけ。
茉莉ちゃんと同じなんだから。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: We're... the same, huh? But, I respect you, Hiyori-san! True respect!
text_block_list.orig_text:
同じ……
ッスか。
でも
自分は
ひよりさんを尊敬するッス！
リスペクトッスよー！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: H-Huh? This is... That's right. It's the Tower of Luna!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あれ……
ここは……
そうだ。
ルナの塔っスよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Mm... Haaah... Phew... It seems like I fell asleep, somehow. Is everyone okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
んっ……
はああ……
ふう……
なんだか寝ちゃってたみたいだね。
みんな大丈夫？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Was that... a dream? It seems like it had something to do with my memories... Hmm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
今のは
夢……
ッスかね？
記憶になにか関係あったみたいッスけど……
うーん……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Matsuri-chan?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしたの？　
マツリちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: In the dream I just had, I... understood... Hiyori-san, after all, there's no need for you to aim to be a hero...
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきの夢で、
自分……
分かったッス……
ヒヨリさんはやっぱり
ヒーローを目指す必要はないッスね……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! I'm fine the way I am now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんうん、
あたしは今のままでいいよ。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: That's right, pal! You're fine the way you are! Helping and cheering up everyone is a great hero's job. Unlike me, you can do that already, so you're already a HERO! Hiyori-san!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうッス！　
今のままでいいッス！
みんなを助けて元気づけるのも、
立派なヒーローの仕事ッス。
それができているヒヨリさんは
自分と違ってもうすでにヒーローッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: HUUUUUUH?! WAS I A HERO ALL ALONG?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ？　
あたし、
すでにヒーローだったんだ！？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: That's why... Hiyori-san, no... Master! Please take me under your wing as your apprentice!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから……
ヒヨリさん、
いえ……
師匠！
自分を弟子にしてほしいッス！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: EEE-EEEHEHEHEHEH?! M-Master?! A Master, that's...? I'm troubled when you say things like that. I'm still a novice myself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
えええええ！？　
し、
師匠～！？
師匠って……
そんなこと言われても困っちゃうよ～
あたし自身がまだまだ未熟者なのに。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: I-Is that a no, then?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダ、
ダメッスか？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I really can't be a "Master", but... maybe we could make this work as friends? So, next time, let's join together and help people in trouble. If they're in trouble, we'll help each other out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん、
師匠は無理だけど……
お友達じゃダメかな？
それで、
今度は一緒に困ってる人たちを助けに行こうよ。
困った時はお互いさまさま、
って。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: "We'll help each other out", pal?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お互いさまさま、
ッスか？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: I'll be there to continue my dream of helping everyone. While you'll continue training to be a hero, Matsuri-chan. How about we work hard together during our days off?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしはみんなのお手伝いとして。
マツリちゃんはヒーローの修行として。
お休みの時なんかに、
一緒に頑張るのは
どうかな？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Understood! I'm counting on you too, pal! And when that time comes, {0} will also be with us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かったッス！
こちらこそ、
ぜひお願いするッス！
その時は、
{0}さんも一緒ッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Yeah, of course! Then, next time you have a day off, let's all go out into town! YEAAAAAH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんうん！　
それじゃあ、
今度のお休みに
みんなで街にくりだそう！　
おー！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: YEAAAAAH, indeed, pal!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おー！　
ッス！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: With that, their adventure in the Tower of Luna came to a close without incident, and the tiger-patterned helping hand duo was born in Landosol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして、ルナの塔での冒険は無事に幕を閉じ、
ランドソルにトラ柄の人助けコンビが誕生したのであった。
